mapper.select: SELECT b.bidx, b.title, b.author, b.publisher, r.status, DATE_FORMAT(r.regDate, '%Y.%m.%d') AS regDate, r.rqidx, r.rejectionReason FROM request r JOIN books b ON r.bidx = b.bidx JOIN `user` u ON r.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.uidx = #{uidx} and u.delyn = "N" and b.delyn = "N" and r.delyn = "N" ORDER BY r.regDate DESC LIMIT #{startPageNum}, #{perPageNum};
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM request r JOIN books b ON r.bidx = b.bidx JOIN `user` u ON r.uidx = u.uidx WHERE u.uidx = #{uidx} and u.delyn = "N" and b.delyn = "N" and r.delyn = "N"
mapper.update: UPDATE request r JOIN books b ON r.bidx = b.bidx JOIN `user` u ON r.uidx = u.uidx SET r.delyn = 'Y' WHERE u.uidx = #{uidx} AND b.bidx = #{bidx} AND r.delyn = 'N' AND b.delyn = 'N' AND u.delyn = 'N'
